title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC O-Level English Language Paper 1
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC O-Level English Language Paper 1 (Composition): choose one composition from seven titles (30 marks) and write one guided composition (20 marks), 1 hour 30 minutes, 50 marks. Titles and tasks are drawn from the bank, so every attempt is a new paper. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its texts and questions are not past-paper material.
instructions:
Answer **one** question from Section A and the question in Section B. You have 1 hour 30 minutes.

- Section A (30 marks): write a composition of about 450-600 words on one of the seven titles.
- Section B (20 marks): write the guided composition in the format the task asks for.
- Plan before you write, paragraph your work and check your spelling and punctuation.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, matching and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows ZIMSEC O-Level English Language Paper 1 as described in the 2015-2022 syllabus. Check the instructions and word lengths on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC O-Level English Language Paper 2
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC O-Level English Language Paper 2: a prose passage with comprehension questions and a summary (Section A, 40 marks) and language-structure questions set in the context of the passage (Section B, 10 marks), 2 hours, 50 marks. A different passage may be drawn each attempt. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its texts and questions are not past-paper material.
instructions:
Read the passage carefully, then answer **all** the questions. You have 2 hours.

- Section A (40 marks): comprehension questions and a summary. Answer in your own words where the question asks you to.
- Section B (10 marks): language questions based on the passage.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, matching and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows ZIMSEC O-Level English Language Paper 2 as described in the 2015-2022 syllabus. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
